title: TrackRails
summary: A genuine Rails 7 project tracker on Postgres with a mass-assignment / IDOR flaw (params.permit! on /users/:id lets a member set their own role to admin), plus a segmented internal ops host. The admin-only /ops panel leaks a deploy SSH password that is REUSED on the pivot (deploy@ops.trackrails.lab); a NOPASSWD sudo rule on the pivot escalates to root and the crown-jewel production keys. Theme: lateral movement.

cmd: SELECT email FROM users WHERE role = 'admin' LIMIT 1
